section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Delémont; other communes differ) and church tax

section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Jura)
label: Who levies it
value: Every municipality (taxe immobilière), on the official value of real estate of natural and legal persons
note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Jura)
label: Rate range
value: 0.5 to 1.8 per mille of the official value
note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Jura)
label: Transfer duty rate
value: Not confirmed for 2026: the ESTV gives 2.1% (legislation as of 1 January 2022); a 2023 government bill (Plan équilibre 22-26) proposed 2.5% up to CHF 1 million and 2.9% above and the end of the reduced rate for a first home; the law in force was not read
note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
source_title: République et Canton du Jura: Plan équilibre 22-26, révision partielle de la loi réglant les droits de mutation (LDMG), press release of 03.07.2023; ESTV Dossier Handänderungssteuer (legislation as of 1 January 2022)
